metadata.question: Was there more sediment in the Mekong River, specifically at location (20.248364, 100.141422), in January 27, 2015 compared to January 25, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to compare sediment levels at a specific point in the Mekong River - Two dates: January 27, 2015 and January 25, 2020 - Sediment can be measured using turbidity or Total Suspended Matter (TSM) - Best options: Sentinel-2 (from 2015 onwards) or Landsat 8/9 - For 2015: Landsat 8 is best option (Sentinel-2 started mid-2015) - For 2020: Can use Sentinel-2 or Landsat 8 - Will use a date range around each target date (±3 days) to ensure data availability 2. Masking strategy: - Should mask clouds since we want clear water observations - Use QA bands for cloud masking - For sediment, we can use bands that correlate with turbidity (Red, NIR bands) - Or calculate turbidity indices 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid zero would be legitimate low sediment readings - C1: No images found in date range - C2: Images exist but all pixels masked out - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN or unrealistic values - Compare values: if 2015 > 2020, answer A; else answer B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([100.141422, 20.248364]); const date1 = '2015-01-27'; const date2 = '2020-01-25'; // Create date ranges (±3 days for flexibility) const start1 = '2015-01-24'; const end1 = '2015-01-30'; const start2 = '2020-01-22'; const end2 = '2020-01-28'; // 2. Data Acquisition for 2015 (Landsat 8) let col1 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(point) .filterDate(start1, end1) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 50)); const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2015 Images found: ${size1}`); if (size1 === 0) { console.log("No data for 2015."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Data Acquisition for 2020 (Try Sentinel-2 first, then Landsat 8) let col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(point) .filterDate(start2, end2) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 50)); let size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2020 Sentinel-2 Images found: ${size2}`); if (size2 === 0) { console.log("Trying Landsat 8 for 2020..."); col2 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(point) .filterDate(start2, end2) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 50)); size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2020 Landsat 8 Images found: ${size2}`); } if (size2 === 0) { console.log("No data for 2020."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 4. Process 2015 data (Landsat 8) function maskL8clouds(image) { const qaMask = image.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(parseInt('11111', 2)).eq(0); return image.updateMask(qaMask) .select(['SR_B4', 'SR_B5']) .multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); } const img1 = col1.map(maskL8clouds).median(); // Calculate turbidity proxy (Red band is good for sediment) const turbidity1Result = img1.select('SR_B4').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: point, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const count1 = img1.select('SR_B4').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: point, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('SR_B4').getInfo(); console.log(`2015 Valid pixels: ${count1}`); if (count1 === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels for 2015 after masking."); console.log("C2"); return; } const turbidity1 = turbidity1Result.get('SR_B4').getInfo(); // 5. Process 2020 data let img2, turbidity2, count2; if (col2.first().bandNames().getInfo().includes('B4')) { // Sentinel-2 function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(cloudMask) .select(['B4', 'B8']) .multiply(0.0001); } img2 = col2.map(maskS2clouds).median(); const turbidity2Result = img2.select('B4').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: point, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); count2 = img2.select('B4').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: point, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('B4').getInfo(); turbidity2 = turbidity2Result.get('B4').getInfo(); } else { // Landsat 8 img2 = col2.map(maskL8clouds).median(); const turbidity2Result = img2.select('SR_B4').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: point, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); count2 = img2.select('SR_B4').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: point, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('SR_B4').getInfo(); turbidity2 = turbidity2Result.get('SR_B4').getInfo(); } console.log(`2020 Valid pixels: ${count2}`); if (count2 === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels for 2020 after masking."); console.log("C2"); return; } // 6. Validation & Final Answer console.log(`2015 Sediment proxy (Red reflectance): ${turbidity1}`); console.log(`2020 Sediment proxy (Red reflectance): ${turbidity2}`); if (turbidity1 === null || turbidity2 === null || isNaN(turbidity1) || isNaN(turbidity2) || turbidity1 < 0 || turbidity2 < 0 || turbidity1 > 1 || turbidity2 > 1) { console.log("Invalid calculation results."); console.log("C3"); return; } if (turbidity1 > turbidity2) { console.log("2015 had more sediment than 2020."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("2015 did not have more sediment than 2020."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
